verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents scoped or restricted API keys, or least-privilege credentials for agents, in Stripe Connect. The adjacent items are not credential scoping: the OAuth flow for connecting accounts, authenticating as a connected account, and the existence of an MCP server and CLI. The axis applies to a payments platform, so absence of evidence is 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
